active_family: 663a bounded-IV state-aware normalized-innovation conditional law; first backend is AR flow matching but backend changes require protocol diagnostics
single_framework_candidate_gate: A framework candidate must freeze one recipe and evaluate it on iv_only, anchor_only, and joint. Allowed differences are input/output dimensionality, support transforms, input heads, decoder heads, and deterministic channel/group balancing. Scope-specific losses, loss weights, backend, prior, sampler, calibration layer, or glued separately sampled decks are not allowed for a framework claim.
current_framework_status: First frozen tri-scope baseline established in 688a: 674a/675a IV-only, 688a anchor-only, and 676a joint38 share the zero-center normalized-innovation AR flow recipe with rollout energy 0.2, channel-level energy 0.05, train samples 2, rollout steps 4, all train windows, no contrast, no AR1 prior. It is a real framework-lock baseline but not final deployable. 698b introduced the first promising successor data-object: innovation-score AR flow. 712a codified the general acceptance scorecard: IV 11-suite with risk-state conditionality replacement, anchor panel gate, joint panel gate, and single-framework gate. The current task-specialized frontier fails all four gates and cannot be called one deployable general conditional law.
normalization_policy: support-aware encoded levels; daily encoded increments; history-only fixed EWMA/RMS scale with robust floor; zero center remains the deployable incumbent. 679a/680a falsified full EWMA mean centering as too deterministic even with rollout-energy repair; 681a falsified EWMA drift as an added conditioning feature because it still over-amplified drift/mean-reversion and damaged level/path allocation.
backend_switch_policy: Do not switch AR/one-shot, flow/diffusion/copula, or Transformer/other backbone until required audits classify the failure as backend failure rather than data framing, reconstruction, conditionality, diversity, dependency, or distribution shift.
research_axis_policy: Change one axis per iteration unless diagnostics prove coupling. Axes: data_object, temporal_factorization, backend, encoder, dependency_structure, calibration.
literature_search_policy: Search papers/official sources during diagnosis when a failure class repeats twice, a methodology/backend/encoder/temporal switch is considered, a normalization failure is not understood, local fixes are exhausted, or model limitation is about to be claimed.
current_bottleneck: The official objective has been clarified: IV 11/11 is necessary but not sufficient. The active family must also pass anchor, joint, and single-framework gates. Current normalized-innovation artifacts fail IV coverage/regime, anchor/joint factor KS and conditional-panel checks, and framework consistency when mixing 674a/688a/698b.
last_result_summary: 712a added experiments/backfill/block_ar/acceptance_scorecard_712a.py, docs/research_protocols/712a_general_acceptance_scorecard.md, and a current-frontier scorecard artifact. The scorecard treats risk-state allocation as the replacement/supplement for old IV conditionality, adds anchor and joint panel gates, and enforces the single-framework gate. Running it on 674a IV + 688a anchor + 698b joint returns overall_pass=false with IV, anchor, joint, and framework all false.
next_step_recommendation: Continue normalized-innovation research against the 712a scorecard. The next model experiment should use one frozen framework recipe and target the shared failures in order: IV lower-tail/regime under-inclusion, then anchor/joint factor KS and conditional-panel response, while preserving framework consistency.
current_best_note: 510a/392a remain historical IV-only controls. Within the clean general state-aware normalized-innovation family, 674a IV-only and 698b joint38 score 7/11 under current diagnostics and pass population risk-state allocation. Under the 712a general acceptance scorecard, however, no current candidate is deployable as a generic conditional law because the current best artifacts do not pass IV, anchor, joint, and framework gates simultaneously.
oracle_feasibility_note: 435a reaches 11/11 only as a validation-future oracle upper bound; it is not a deployable or learned conditional scenario generator.
